comments.author: Arcus56
comments.body_html:
You’re missing a comma after your first tool entry, fix & example below.

{
  "_id": "CHR_Recipe_01",
  "areaType": 7,
  "requiredLevel": 3,
  "productionTime": 5580,
  "endProduct": "5e8488fa988a8701445df1e4",
  "count": 2,
  "needFuelForAllProductionTime": true,
  "inputs": [
    { "tpl": "5c0e533786f7747fa23f4d47", "count": 1 }
  ],
  "tools": [
    {"tpl": "5d1b3f2d86f774253763b735", "count": 1} <------ Must have comma after first tool, or input option if we're going to use a second one. 
    {"tpl": "5d1b31ce86f7742523398394", "count": 1}
  ]
}

Fixed json with comma added, feel free to copy & paste!


{
  "_id": "CHR_Recipe_01",
  "areaType": 7,
  "requiredLevel": 3,
  "productionTime": 5580,
  "endProduct": "5e8488fa988a8701445df1e4",
  "count": 2,
  "needFuelForAllProductionTime": true,
  "inputs": [
    { "tpl": "5c0e533786f7747fa23f4d47", "count": 1 }
  ],
  "tools": [
    {"tpl": "5d1b3f2d86f774253763b735", "count": 1},
    {"tpl": "5d1b31ce86f7742523398394", "count": 1}
  ]
}
